name: cooking
description: Weight/thaw-based timed cooking at stoves (flags.stove_tier) or a carried portable oven (tags.portable_oven). `cook <food|vessel>` — background/lazy, no tick; a bounded set of timers narrate stage transitions and completion, rescheduled on boot. Food tagged `food_profile` adds depth: a peak window, a burn point, handling (`flip`/`stir`), and a quality band stamped by `plate` that scales the meal's effects and awards Cooking IP. `stove` is an 11-position dial (0=off .. 10) whose three named tiers are notches on it — the fine position sets the cook RATE and 0 pauses the session outright (heat.js: apparent time + session translation, identity at rate 1); the tier is still the only scoring axis. `pour`/`empty` tip a pan's fluids out or decant them into another pan. Owns the shared `cook` verb and routes drug-cooking to plugins/synthesis via the `synthesis.cook` Action; a room holding both a stove and a chem lab disambiguates through SIFT. Bread is an EDIBLE vessel (tags.edible_vessel): sandwiches are assembled in it, an unmatched one is named off its contents rather than becoming slop, and `butter` counts as the dish fat. `cut` halves a finished dish. `heat` is an alias.

specializedActions.note: Puts WATER in a pot as an ordinary ingredient row (item_water, tags.cooking_medium), which is what dry starch now needs before it will cook. Registered ahead of the fillable plugin (alphabetical) and falls through for anything also tagged `fillable` — drinkware is a vessel too and stays entirely fillable's/drinks'. Needs flags.water_source furniture in the room; foul water stamps custom_data.hazards.disease_risk so plating carries it through.

`pour <jug of oil> into <pan>` draws ONE MEASURE off a fat_or_oil item and leaves the jug, instead of tipping 600g of oil into a pan to fry one egg. The measure lands as an ordinary ingredient row (the same call `fill` made about water) and counts as one dose, so a jug is five dishes. ⚠ Registered ahead of drinks and fillable alphabetically, so it sees `pour` for every canteen and cup first and MUST fall through — every early exit returns undefined.
Tips the cooking medium back out of a pot. Falls through unless the vessel actually holds one, so `empty <canteen>` still reaches the fillable plugin.

Declaration-only. Advertises the workspace plugin's HUD on a range/microwave/dish cabinet — cooking declares it because the flags are cooking's vocabulary, not the workspace plugin's. Also registered for `microwave` and `dish_cabinet`.

cook.note: Shared verb. Routes target-first: a carried needs_cooking/vessel item is food, anything else is a synthesis recipe. Bare `cook` in a room with both a stove and a chem lab raises a SIFT station prompt, replayed through the cooking.station_choice Action.

extensionPoints: Cookbook tablet app (plugins/tablet/cookbook-app.js) reads the cookbook: player_flags.
